trend.up.simple.headline: "{metric}" rose {pct}% {compare}.
trend.up.simple.meaning: Results are moving the right way. Knowing why helps you keep it going.

trend.up.expert.headline: "{metric}" rose {pct}% {compare}.

trend.down.simple.headline: "{metric}" fell {pct}% {compare}.

anomaly.up.simple.headline: On {date}, "{metric}" rose sharply to {value} (usually about {typical}).
anomaly.up.simple.meaning: A jump like this can come from a data error, a promotion or an unexpected event.
anomaly.up.simple.next_step: Check the records for that day and find the cause.

anomaly.up.expert.headline: On {date}, "{metric}" rose sharply to {value} (usually about {typical}).
anomaly.up.expert.meaning: A jump like this can come from a data error, a promotion or an unexpected event.
anomaly.up.expert.next_step: Check the records for that day and find the cause.
anomaly.up.expert.details: Method: distance from the usual value (z-score {z}). Observations: {n}.

anomaly.down.simple.headline: On {date}, "{metric}" fell sharply to {value} (usually about {typical}).
anomaly.down.simple.meaning: A drop like this can point to an outage, a data error or weak demand.

anomaly.down.expert.headline: On {date}, "{metric}" fell sharply to {value} (usually about {typical}).

churn.up.simple.headline: The share of customers who did not come back rose: {rate}% of last month's customers (usually {baseline}%).
